import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to categorical data type
data['Gender'] = data['Gender'].astype('category')
data['Occupation'] = data['Occupation'].astype('category')
data['BMI Category'] = data['BMI Category'].astype('category')
data['Blood Pressure'] = data['Blood Pressure'].astype('category')
data['Sleep Disorder'] = data['Sleep Disorder'].astype('category')

# Create a violin plot to compare the distribution of sleep duration across different age groups
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Sleep Duration', data=data)
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution Across Different Age Groups')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.show()

# Save the figure as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart to compare the average daily steps across different physical activity levels
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', data=data)
plt.title('Average Daily Steps Across Different Physical Activity Levels')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.show()

# Save the figure as output.png (overwrites previous figure)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.show()
